record.reason: PlanFence is a dependency-scoped validation protocol for distributed LLM-agent shared memory: plans cite their input records and executors validate only action-relevant dependencies before acting, eliminating stale-plan execution in 30 five-agent workflows; it concerns agent coordination correctness, not model inference systems.
record.title: Fresh Memory, Stale Plans: Dependency-Scoped Validation for Distributed LLM-Agent Memory
